page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 7T83 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration, and it does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized resource. It offers high compute density for parallel processing tasks, though the lack of local storage requires architectural planning for I/O-heavy workloads. This configuration is designed for compute-heavy workloads such as batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and scientific modeling where CPU capacity is prioritized over memory volume.
